description: Ministry of Port, Shipping and Aviation - Licensing of Shipping Agents Freight Forwarders, Non Vessel Operating Common Carriers and Container Operators Act. No 10 of 1972
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation under the Licensing of Shipping Agents, Freight Forwarders, Non-Vessel Operating Common Carriers and Container Operators Act, No. 10 of 1972. It amends existing regulations regarding the structure of charges for shipping and freight services, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes. The content focuses on regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for commercial shipping operations.
